commands:
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
cd "$ROOT"
echo "BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)"
echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "DIRTY_COUNT=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "NODE_MODULES=$(test -e frontend/node_modules/@playwright/test && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "REMOTE_FEATURE=$(git ls-remote --heads origin feat/unified-map-ux-20261104)"
echo "WORKTREES"
git worktree list --porcelain
echo "DIAGNOSTIC_FINISHED"
